idea.title: AI headshot generator: 10 selfies to 40 LinkedIn headshots for $29

source.text: An AI headshot generator: upload 10 selfies, get 40 professional LinkedIn headshots for $29. Launch country US, budget $2,000, 10 hours a week, goal side income, edge: I am a developer. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug ai-headshots.

idea.problem: Professionals need a polished LinkedIn headshot without paying for a photographer.
idea.customer: US professionals and job seekers updating their LinkedIn profile
idea.solution: Web app: upload 10 selfies, a fine-tuned image model returns 40 professional headshots.
claims: upload 10 selfies, get 40 professional LinkedIn headshots for $29
assumptions: No existing audience, list or customers in the niche (not stated; user said 'just go')
No validation done yet (no waitlist, no pre-sales)
Generation runs on a hosted model API (fal.ai / Replicate / Astria), not own GPUs
Stripe for payments at US standard fees (2.9% + $0.30, not verified on a US page)

confidence.note: A US Google Keyword Planner CPC and a real conversion rate from a 7-day test would firm up CAC

gross_margin.note: About **79%**: ~$6 variable cost per $29 order (fal.ai training $2 + images + Stripe), before refunds

ltv_cac.note: LTV ~$23 vs paid CAC ~$286: **0.08**. Fix path: affiliates at 30% ($8.70 CAC) give ~2.6, but none exist yet

pricing_power.note: Gemini does it free; HeadshotPro already sells 30 headshots at the same $29

build_effort.note: Hosted LoRA training + generation APIs exist; a developer can ship a test in 1-2 weeks

skills_match.note: Developer covers the build; marketing and SEO skills are missing

capital_needed.note: About $30/month fixed plus ~$6 per order: fits a $2,000 budget easily

time_to_mvp.note: 2-3 weeks at 10 h/week to a paid checkout (estimate)

sales_cycle.note: Impulse, same-day consumer purchase; incumbents deliver in 15 min to 2 h

channel_readiness.note: No audience; SEO leader entrenched (keyword difficulty 74); paid CPC $5.71 never pays back (R5)

search_demand.note: 'ai headshot generator' ~22,200 searches/month worldwide; 270M US LinkedIn members

trend.note: Mid-tier headshot sites lost 43-100% of traffic in Sept 2026; Lensa revenue -58% in 2023 (R5)

willingness_to_pay.note: HeadshotPro reports $10M+ revenue and 200,000+ shoots; Aragon 7,429 Trustpilot reviews

free_alternatives.note: Gemini Nano Banana turns one selfie into a LinkedIn headshot free (R1)

competitor_density.note: 25+ named products, 5+ Product Hunt clones in 4 months, generic-name slugs up to '-8'

differentiation.note: Same input, output and price as HeadshotPro and Aragon; 'I am a developer' is not an edge

legal_regulatory.note: Face photos fall under Illinois BIPA; Lensa was sued for the same flow in 2023

platform_dependency.note: Depends on model APIs (fal, Replicate, Astria) and Stripe, but alternatives exist

market_risk.note: Free frontier models are absorbing the category; Levels: 'BigAI is cannibalizing'

skills.note: Strong on build, no stated marketing or distribution track record

assets.note: No audience, list, data or affiliate network stated

interest.note: Goal is side income; no stated passion for photography or careers

tam.reasoning: Vendor estimates: >$350M in 2025 (BetterPic) and $350-500M (ProShoot); no independent analyst tracks it, so low end used

sam.reasoning: TAM $350M x 40% assumed US share (largest LinkedIn market, 270M members)

som.reasoning: SAM $140M x 0.1% realistic solo year-1 share; requires a working channel, which is missing

churn_monthly_pct.reasoning: One-off purchase, no subscription; no repeat-purchase data published

expected_lifetime.reasoning: Headshots bought once per job change; no repeat-rate data found

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: Assumed visitor-to-purchase benchmark for a $29 one-off consumer purchase; no sourced benchmark

ltv_cac.reasoning: LTV $23 / CAC $286; via affiliates at 30% commission it would be ~2.6 but no affiliates exist

payback_months.reasoning: One-off margin $23 never covers a $286 paid CAC

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: Domain, hosting, storage, email: ~$30/month assumed; hosting price pages not checked

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 2-3 weeks build at 10 h/week + 1 week of organic posting to get a first sale

verdict.launch_reason: Set by the user; the largest LinkedIn market with 270M members.

rules_applied.effect: no_distribution hit and LTV:CAC 0.08: total 57 capped at 49

verdict.cheapest_test: Fake-door B2B test: 50 cold emails to US HR/ops leads offering team headshots at $29/seat, with a pre-sale link
kill_criteria: Fewer than 5 replies to 50 cold emails by day 7 -> stop
0 paid team orders (any size) by day 14 -> archive
Refund or redo requests above 10% of the first 20 orders -> stop

rescue.change: Sell team headshots to US companies of 10-100 staff by cold email to HR/ops, $29 per seat, with brand-matched backgrounds
rescue.why: Fixes ltv_cac (10-50 seats per deal) and channel_readiness (direct outreach); free Gemini is not a team workflow
rescue.requires: Cold outreach skills the founder lacks; competes with BetterPic Teams at $49/seat

rescue.change: White-label the pipeline for career coaches, resume writers and university career centers on revenue share
rescue.why: Borrows their audience to fix no_distribution and assets; partners carry the trust
rescue.requires: Partner sales; partners can use free Gemini themselves

type_checks.note: One-off purchase with no subscription; leader sells only one-time packages, so lifetime is about 1 purchase and every sale needs new acquisition
Zero switching cost: buyers compare per-shoot prices ($17-59) and a free Gemini option, with 14-30 day refunds as the norm

narrative.answer: **NO-GO**. Free Gemini already does the job, HeadshotPro sells the same $29 package with $10M+ in revenue, and with no audience a paid customer costs ~$286 against **$23** of margin.
tldr: Free **Gemini Nano Banana** turns one selfie into a LinkedIn headshot; mainstream press publishes the prompts.
HeadshotPro sells **30 headshots for $29** and reports $10M+ revenue; 25+ look-alikes split the rest.
One-off $29 with ~$23 margin cannot fund paid search at **$5.71 a click**: LTV:CAC 0.08.

key_findings.title: Free does the whole job
key_findings.detail: Gemini **Nano Banana** makes a professional headshot from one selfie for free, and TechRepublic publishes the prompts (2026-03).

key_findings.title: The leader sells your exact offer
key_findings.detail: HeadshotPro charges **$29** for 30 headshots and reports **$10M+** revenue from 200,000+ shoots since 2023.

key_findings.title: Paid acquisition loses money per sale
key_findings.detail: At **$5.71 CPC** and 2% conversion a customer costs ~$286 against ~$23 of one-off margin (estimate).

narrative.recommendation: Archive the consumer $29 offer. If you want this stack to earn, run the 7-day B2B team-headshot cold-email test first and stop at fewer than 5 replies.
narrative.steelman: Demand is proven: HeadshotPro made **$10M+** and buyers save ~$275 versus a $304 photographer. A developer can ship in 2 weeks for under $100. Checked: true, but the leader owns SEO and affiliates, and free Gemini erodes the convenience gap.

premortem.cause: No channel: paid clicks at $5.71 never pay back and SEO for 'ai headshot' stays owned by HeadshotPro.
premortem.early_signal: Fewer than 1 sale per 100 paid clicks, or 0 organic visits by day 30

premortem.cause: Buyers try free Gemini first and only pay the incumbent they already trust.
premortem.early_signal: Checkout conversion under 1% of landing visitors

premortem.cause: An Illinois user files a BIPA claim over face data used without written consent.
premortem.early_signal: Any Illinois order processed without a logged written e-consent

changes.what: Google's Gemini image model (Nano Banana) makes headshots from one selfie free; press runs prompt guides
BetterPic gives up to 10 free 4K headshots, pushing the price floor to $0
Mid-tier AI headshot sites lose 43-100% of traffic month over month
Pieter Levels: big AI models are cannibalizing indie apps

why_now.note: The window opened in 2023 and is closing: frontier models now give the core output away.

icp.who: US professionals aged 25-45 in a job search or a new role, updating LinkedIn
icp.pays_for_today: A photographer at $304 on average (Thumbtack, 2026-10), or HeadshotPro at $29-59 one-off
icp.trigger: Starting a job search, a new job or promotion, or a company asking for a profile photo

rescue.change: Sell team headshots to US companies of 10-100 staff by cold email to HR/ops, $29 per seat, with brand-matched backgrounds
rescue.why: Fixes ltv_cac (10-50 seats per deal) and channel_readiness (direct outreach); free Gemini is not a team workflow
rescue.requires: Cold outreach skills the founder lacks; competes with BetterPic Teams at $49/seat

rescue.change: White-label the pipeline for career coaches, resume writers and university career centers on revenue share
rescue.why: Borrows their audience to fix no_distribution and assets; partners carry the trust
rescue.requires: Partner sales; partners can use free Gemini themselves

free_alternative.evidence: Gemini Nano Banana makes a LinkedIn headshot from one selfie free (TechRepublic, 2026-03); BetterPic gives 10 free 4K headshots (2026-08).

strong_competitor.evidence: HeadshotPro reports $10M+ revenue and 200,000+ shoots; Aragon has 7,429 Trustpilot reviews and claims 750k users (2026-11).

graveyard.evidence: Lensa revenue fell 58% in 2023; Evoto removed its AI headshot tool (2026-01); Aiheadshotmasters and Headpix AI at zero visits in Sept 2026.

no_distribution.evidence: CPC $5.71 on 'ai headshot generator' (keyword difficulty 74) vs ~$23 margin; Aragon already runs 2,000+ affiliates at 30%. No audience.

costs_eat_margin.evidence: Checked fal.ai ($2 training, $0.035/image) and Replicate (under $2 per run): ~$6 per order, ~79% gross margin. Clear.

weak_demand.evidence: Mid-tier sites lost 43-100% of traffic in Sept 2026 while Canva grew 27.5%; Lensa revenue -58% in 2023. Demand moves to free tools.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: Lensa was hit with a 7-count BIPA class action (2023-02) for collecting facial geometry from selfies; damages $1,000-5,000 per person.

saturated_wave.evidence: 10 look-alikes found: 5 dated Product Hunt launches (AiProPortrait, ProHeadshot AI, Express Headshot AI...), a Show HN, 4 undated; PH slug 'ai-headshot-generator-8'.

customer.segment: US professionals and job seekers updating LinkedIn
customer.pain: Need a credible photo fast without a $200-400 photographer
customer.today: Photographer ($304 avg), HeadshotPro/Aragon ($29-75), or free Gemini prompts

use_cases.name: Team headshots for small companies, per seat
use_cases.who_pays: HR / ops at a 10-100 person company

use_cases.name: White-label for career coaches and resume writers
use_cases.who_pays: Coach or service, on revenue share

competitors.name: Google Gemini (Nano Banana)
competitors.gap: Daily caps, prompt work, no batch of 40

scenarios.name: Optimistic
scenarios.note: Affiliates at 25% drive most sales: $30 + 60 x $6 + $435 commission

risks.risk: Illinois BIPA class action over face data
risks.mitigation: Written e-consent at upload, published retention policy, delete photos and weights in 7 days

risks.risk: Refund and redo demands on likeness
risks.mitigation: Copy Aragon's 'download counts as use' rule; preview before delivery

risks.risk: Free models improve further and remove the paid gap
risks.mitigation: Move to team or B2B workflow free tools do not cover

risks.risk: Model API price or terms change
risks.mitigation: Abstract the provider; fal and Replicate both offer FLUX LoRA

test_plan.step: List 50 US companies of 10-100 staff with mismatched LinkedIn team photos
test_plan.verify: 50 named HR/ops contacts in a sheet

test_plan.step: One landing page: team headshots, $29/seat, Stripe pre-sale link, sample grid
Send 50 cold emails or LinkedIn DMs, 1 follow-up each
Offer a paid pilot for the first team (5 seats minimum)

narrative.lesson: A thin wrapper on a model that frontier labs give away free has no moat; distribution is the product.
